content.short: Flitpay is a free-to-use India-based crypto exchange for trading and investing.
content.description: Flitpay is a free-to-use platform that supports crypto and fiat withdrawals and deposits, along with a wide range of trading features for its users. As a pioneer in Indian crypto exchanges, Flitpay introduced physical Bitcoin and crypto gift cards. It also offers an earn feature that lets users stake their crypto assets to earn interest. With a quick buy/sell option, Flitpay provides zero-fee trading for a fast, cost-efficient experience.
